scripts.demo:supply-chain: PYTHONPATH=.:libs:apps/cli:apps/api uv run python -m foundry_lite_cli.main demo run-supply-chain
scripts.demo:supply-chain:fake-storage: rm -rf .foundry-lite-fake-smoke && FOUNDRY_LITE_HOME=.foundry-lite-fake-smoke PYTHONPATH=.:libs:apps/cli:apps/api uv run python -m foundry_lite_cli.main --adapter-profile fake-storage demo run-supply-chain
scripts.quality:complexity: uv run radon cc libs apps scripts -s -a && uv run xenon --max-absolute B --max-modules B --max-average A libs apps scripts
scripts.quality:infra-boundaries: uv run python scripts/quality/check_infra_import_boundary.py --max-application-imports 11 && uv run python scripts/quality/check_mixin_method_conflicts.py
scripts.quality:static: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy libs apps/api apps/cli apps/worker scripts && uv run pyright && uv run python scripts/quality/check_dependency_graph.py && uv run python scripts/quality/check_infra_import_boundary.py --max-application-imports 11 && uv run python scripts/quality/check_mixin_method_conflicts.py && uv run python scripts/quality/check_application_module_size.py --max-lines 500 && uv run python scripts/quality/check_no_test_bypasses.py
scripts.test:coverage: PYTHONPATH=.:libs:apps/cli:apps/api uv run python -m pytest tests --cov=libs/foundry_lite --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95
scripts.lint: PYTHONPATH=.:libs:apps/cli:apps/api uv run python -m compileall libs apps tests
